title: ECDC: DRC Ebola toll reaches 11,504 confirmed cases, 5,630 deaths
detail: ECDC's 17 November update (data through 16 November) reports 11,504 confirmed Bundibugyo cases and 5,630 deaths in the DRC with ongoing community transmission. Ituri remains the worst-hit province (7,858 cases, 3,715 deaths as of 15 November, 28 of 36 health zones). Africa CDC separately said on 15 November the outbreak is 'still not under control'.
